pagesChanged.name: hr-positions
pagesChanged.notes: 唯一岗位工作区。查询参数：?tab=catalog|headcount|grades 与 ?position=<id>&detail=overview|staff|requirements|headcount 可刷新/分享；tab 与 detail 非法值回落到 catalog/overview。

routeChanges: KEEP GET /v1/positions; ADD query parameters org_unit_id, status=ACTIVE|DISABLED, page, page_size (1..100), sort=code|code_desc|title|level; filter/count/page after Authorizer::constrain(org.position.read).
KEEP GET /v1/positions/{id}; ADD as_of query parameter and validate it with BusinessDateRule.
KEEP GET /v1/positions/{id}/staff (org.position.staff.read); response remains a live projection whose rows come only from AssignmentDirectory::positionIncumbents.
KEEP GET/POST /v1/positions/{id}/requirements (org.position.qualification.manage); POST stays CommandRunner idempotent and appends exactly one version per key.
KEEP GET/POST /v1/positions/grades (org.position.grade.manage, COMPANY); the workspace renders this catalogue in the grades tab.

KEEP POST /v1/positions and PATCH /v1/positions/{id}; both now run through CommandRunner with required Idempotency-Key, AuditRecorder evidence and org.position.manage scope (create additionally verifies the target org unit).
No redirects: the four folded page paths are removed from registry, pages barrel and catalog and must return 404.
notes: Required lead integration outside this worker's strict file domain: remove the four registry entries/pages-barrel loaders/people catalog configs and delete PositionHeadcountPage.vue, PositionRequirementsPage.vue, PositionGradesPage.vue, PositionStaffPage.vue; remove the four backend PermissionResourceCatalog page entries; update peoplePages.spec.ts accordingly.

The four old subroute capabilities are now covered by /hr/positions: headcount is a workspace tab + detail section, grades is a workspace tab, requirements is a detail section that reuses PositionRequirementsPanel, and staff is a detail section that requests only /v1/positions/{id}/staff.

No new table or migration is needed: headcount_limit lives on positions, qualification versions on position_qualifications, grades on position_grades, and incumbents are read from People assignments through the existing contracts.

Position create now rejects a duplicate code with 409 reason POSITION_CODE_DUPLICATE; update/disable reject a staffed disable with 409 reason POSITION_STAFFED. Both writes record audit events (org.position.created / org.position.updated|disabled).

Qualification replay returns the original 201 body as 200 with Idempotency-Replayed=true and creates neither a second version nor a second audit event; same key + different payload is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH.
OpenAPI updated only for the position operation surface. Backend endpoint matrix, generated action manifest and capability catalogs are shared integration files and were not edited by this worker.

Executed by this worker: backend PositionQueryTest, PositionStaffProjectionTest, PositionQualificationVersionTest, PositionApiTest, PositionCatalogTest and ModuleScannerTest (filter Position|ModuleScannerTest: 32 tests / 152 assertions OK); frontend PositionWorkspace, positionWorkspaceTabs, positionServerQuery and positionRequirementsPanel (26 tests OK); php -l on all changed PHP files; arch:test OK with 4 pre-existing non-blocking warnings; openapi-lint OK (263 paths / 338 operations); capability:audit OK (6 public allowlisted routes).

NOT RUN by this worker: tests/unit/positionSubroutesRemoved.spec.ts is intentionally red until the lead removes the four old registry entries, pages-barrel loaders, people catalog configs and Vue files. PositionWorkspace.spec.ts, positionWorkspaceTabs.spec.ts, positionServerQuery.spec.ts and positionRequirementsPanel.spec.ts are green (26 tests).

Lead must regenerate frontend/src/generated/api.ts (and any generated contract copies) after merging docs/openapi/openapi.yaml so listPositions exposes org_unit_id/status/page/page_size/sort and required Idempotency-Key headers; generated files are outside this worker domain.

Workspace headcount tab uses the same GET /v1/positions payload as catalog and opens detail headcount; it does not add a second headcount API. Position PATCH must be used for limit changes and remains protected by org.position.manage.
